deployments_detail.use: "BLUE" internal knowledge chatbot — originally a rule-based system matching a knowledge base of ~125,000 expert-written Q&A pairs, re-platformed onto a Microsoft generative-AI model to produce richer, more relevant conversational answers for employees fielding customer questions. [Microsoft (Microsoft AI model)]
AI-enabled configuration tools that help set up/stocking-plan large customer programs, moving them from proposal to implementation with reduced manual effort. [Fastenal (internally developed)]
AI copilots assisting employees/customers with questions and planning as part of applying AI to 'accelerate the path to answers' across the supply chain. [none]

Microsoft M365 Copilot adopted company-wide for employee productivity — digesting reports, summarizing meetings, creating/enhancing content, and producing language translations. Fastenal describes itself as an early adopter. [Microsoft (M365 Copilot)]
AI-powered sourcing tool being built to help Fastenal staff with sourcing/procurement work, following the June AI-upgraded chatbot rollout. [Fastenal (internally developed)]
AI-enabled quoting/configuration tools + managed-inventory tech (FASTVend/FASTStock IoT vending) — 3rd-party sourced, AI branding modest

Internally developed AI-enabled quoting tools that generate customer quotes faster, letting Fastenal implement newly signed large-account business more quickly than in prior years. [Fastenal (internally developed)]
AI-powered product search on Fastenal's digital platform to accelerate customers/employees finding the right products, cited as part of its data-driven supply chain tech building blocks. [none]
Microsoft Copilot used by Fastenal's technical staff to assist with software coding as part of its rollout of AI productivity tools. [Microsoft (M365 Copilot)]
